title: Generic Protocol breaks mypy when attrs class
body:
Please provide more information to help us understand the issue:

* Are you reporting a bug, or opening a feature request?
Bug

* Please insert below the code you are checking with mypy,
  or a mock-up repro if the source is private. We would appreciate
  if you try to simplify your case to a minimal repro.
```
from abc import abstractmethod
from typing import TypeVar

from attr import attrs
from typing_extensions import Protocol

T = TypeVar("T")


@attrs(auto_attribs=True)
class Test(Protocol[T]):
    a: int

    @abstractmethod
    def transition_to(self, t: T):
        raise NotImplementedError
```

* What is the actual behavior/output?
mypy crashes
* What is the behavior/output you expect?
```
test.py:20:1: error: Invariant type variable 'T' used in protocol where contravariant one is expected
test.py:24:5: error: Function is missing a return type annotation
```

* What are the versions of mypy and Python you are using?
  Do you see the same issue after installing mypy from Git master?
Using 701, still exists with master

* What are the mypy flags you are using? (For example --strict-optional)
No config

* If mypy crashed with a traceback, please paste
  the full traceback below.

```
test.py:24:5: error: Function is missing a return type annotation
./test.py:19: error: INTERNAL ERROR -- please report a bug at https://github.com/python/mypy/issues version: 0.701
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/Users/cahurst/.local/share/virtualenvs/automation_engine-fTGkomR2/bin/mypy", line 10, in <module>
    sys.exit(console_entry())
  File "mypy/checker.py", line 395, in accept
  File "mypy/nodes.py", line 896, in accept
  File "mypy/checker.py", line 1528, in visit_class_def__StatementVisitor_glue
  File "mypy/checker.py", line 1568, in visit_class_def
  File "mypy/checker.py", line 1588, in check_protocol_variance
  File "mypy/subtypes.py", line 95, in is_subtype
  File "mypy/types.py", line 625, in accept
  File "mypy/subtypes.py", line 185, in visit_instance__TypeVisitor_glue
  File "mypy/subtypes.py", line 218, in visit_instance
  File "mypy/subtypes.py", line 482, in is_protocol_implementation
AssertionError:
./test.py:19: : note: use --pdb to drop into pdb
```


Removing either the Generic aspect, or removing attrs from the class makes everything work as expected. It only occurs when both are in play at the same time.
